lifecycleScripts.afterStart: npx @wordpress/env run cli sh -c "wp rewrite structure /%postname%/ --quiet && (wp post list --post_type=page --name=tour --format=ids | grep -q . || wp post create --post_type=page --post_title='Schedule a Tour' --post_name=tour --post_status=publish --post_content='[delivery_trace_tour_form]')"
